items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: This little White boy that's a great actor, makes his own movies, he's got a band, a funeral band in New York he calls a funeral parade band.

ctx.x: See, you even have it today. This little White boy that's a great actor, makes his own movies, he's got a band, a funeral band in New York he calls a funeral parade band. Little White boy who makes the greatest movies, what do you call him, with the long nose...
I'm trying to think of his name.
